config.name: Rows per table per minute
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(_timestamp_load) AS ts,
       toString(_source) AS "table",
       count() * 60 / $__interval_s AS "rows/min"
FROM dfe.all_sources
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp_load) AND _table = toString(_source) AND toString(_source) IN ('cisco-asa', 'fortinet', 'demo-syslog', 'component-releases', 'wikipedia-recentchanges')
GROUP BY ts, "table"
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Rows landed
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toString(_source) AS "Table",
       count() AS "Rows"
FROM dfe.all_sources
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp_load) AND _table = toString(_source) AND toString(_source) IN ('cisco-asa', 'fortinet', 'demo-syslog', 'component-releases', 'wikipedia-recentchanges')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

config.name: Records archived (running total)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
       max(Value) AS "records archived"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'messages_archived_total'
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Archiver errors in the time range
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT max(Value) - min(Value) AS "archive errors in range"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'archive_errors_total'
